task.name: put_mouse_basket_from_tray_ep1
task.description: Use the left arm to place the mouse from the green tray into the basket

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the mouse on the green tray.
2. Grasp the mouse with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the basket.
4. Release the gripper to place the mouse into the basket.
